description: ES-TRIN, the European Standard laying down Technical Requirements for Inland Navigation vessels, is drawn up by the European Committee for drawing up Standards in Inland Navigation (CESNI), an international body created within the Central Commission for the Navigation of the Rhine (CCNR). Directive (EU) 2016/1629, in force since 6 October 2016 and applied from 7 October 2018, makes the technical requirements for inland waterway vessels uniform across EU member states by referring to ES-TRIN and its updates, and the CCNR framework refers to the same standard. Coverage: construction, equipment and safety requirements for all types of inland craft, which underpin Union inland navigation certificates valid on all EU inland waterways including the Rhine; vessel and certificate data sit in the European Hull Database. Format and access: the standard is published by CESNI in editions, and the directive and implementing decisions on derogations are on EUR-Lex and the Commission's page. Licence and cost: free to read; no licence was stated on the page read. Caveats: this is a normative text, not a dataset of vessels. The requirements can be used to set vessel classes, equipment and safety constraints in inland fleet and navigation simulation models. It relates to the Inland Electronic Navigational Charts and EuRIS notices to skippers in the catalogue.
